name: hereditary sensory and autonomic neuropathy type 1
description: Hereditary sensory neuropathy type I (HSN I) is a slowly progressive neurological disorder characterized by prominent predominantly distal sensory loss, autonomic disturbances, autosomal dominant inheritance, and juvenile or adulthood disease onset.
